shared_elements: tall upright rectangular carved stone slab/monolith
low-relief carving on a weathered stone surface
horizontal register or band dividing the surface
row of repeated similar motifs across the upper part
animal or creature heads shown in profile
curvilinear/rounded motifs enclosed within rectangular fields
justification: Both are upright slab-shaped stones bearing low relief organised with a horizontal dividing band and a row of repeated motifs along the top, and both include profile creature heads, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a dense, uniform double-column grid of tightly packed ornate cartouches covering the whole face, while B is sparse, open-field carving of a few large flat-silhouetted animal figures, and the two are also different media (fine engraved drawing versus photograph).
